review.en: Written in English in Boston, this short book uses the tea room and its ritual to explain to Western readers a whole Asian sense of taste: Taoist emptiness, Zen simplicity, the beauty of the imperfect and unfinished. It generalises freely and has a gentle polemical edge, but it remains one of the most graceful introductions to that sensibility.
review.zh: 这本小书在波士顿用英文写成，借茶室和茶道向西方读者讲解一整套东亚的趣味：道家的虚，禅的简，残缺与未完成之美。书中概括得相当随意，也带着温和的论战锋芒，但仍是介绍这种感受力最优雅的入门之作之一。
